faq: What does the elephant feed-and-walk visit near Fisherman's Village cost? | 1,000 THB per adult and 500 THB per child (4–11) for the 1-hour visit without transfer, or 3,000 THB per adult and 1,500 THB per child for the 3-hour visit with lunch and return hotel transfer. Children under 4 are free.

Is there riding or an elephant show on the feed-and-walk visit? | No riding and no shows. The programme is preparing food, hand-feeding, walking beside the elephants with their keepers and watching them behave naturally.

Which feed-and-walk option comes with a hotel transfer? | Only with the 3-hour visit, which includes return transfer by air-conditioned van from your hotel lobby or villa gate. For the 1-hour visit you arrive on your own, any time between 09:00 and 15:00.

Can young children join the feed-and-walk elephant visit? | Yes. Children under 4 are free and 4–11-year-olds pay the child price. Keepers brief everyone on where to stand; keep small children by your side, as elephants are large and can move suddenly.

How long is the 3-hour feed-and-walk visit including transfers? | About 3.5 hours door to door: a 09:00 pickup gets you back to your hotel around 12:30. An afternoon departure at 14:00 is also offered. The 1-hour visit is just the time on site.

Does the feed-and-walk elephant visit go ahead in the rain? | Usually yes; the visit is mostly under trees and shelters, and light rain does not stop it. Paths get muddy from October to December, so wear shoes you can wash. In a storm the sanctuary may move your time.

What is the cancellation policy for the feed-and-walk elephant booking? | Cancel 4 or more days before the date for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or no-show there is no refund. If the operator cancels for weather or sea conditions, you choose a new date or a full refund.

What should I wear for the elephant feed-and-walk visit? | Light clothes that can get muddy or stained by fruit, shoes with a strap or trainers, a hat and insect repellent. Leave jewellery and loose bags behind; the elephants are curious.

Golden has 21 ziplines, 33 platforms, about 5,000 m of line, 3 abseils up to 40 m, 3 bridges and 2 sky corridors, and takes about 2 hours.
Do children pay less for the Silver or Golden zipline course? | No. Everyone aged 7 and over pays the same: 1,900 THB for Silver and 2,700 THB for Golden. Children under 7 can't ride.
Is there a weight limit on the Silver and Golden zipline courses? | Yes, 100 kg maximum. The courses are not suitable during pregnancy or for people with heart conditions.

Is hotel transfer included with the jungle zipline park booking? | Yes. A minibus collects you around 08:00 and brings you back around 13:30 (Silver) or 14:30 (Golden). Afternoon pickups are possible on request.

How long does the Golden zipline course day take in total? | Plan on about 6.5 hours from hotel pickup to drop-off, of which about 2 hours is on the course. Most of the rest is the drive and the briefing.

Does the zipline park on Koh Samui open in the rain? | Light rain doesn't stop the course; guides close it during thunderstorms and lightning. From October to December expect wet platforms and muddy paths.

Can I cancel my Silver or Golden zipline course booking? | Cancel 4 or more days before the date for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or no-show there is no refund. If the operator cancels for weather or sea conditions, you choose a new date or a full refund.

What should I wear for the jungle zipline course? | Closed shoes, shorts or light trousers and a T-shirt. Tie back long hair, empty your pockets and leave sunglasses that could fall in the bag at the start.

How long should I allow for an 8-minute go-kart session? | About an hour on site for check-in, a short safety talk, putting on the helmet and the session itself, longer at busy times.

Can you race the Samui karts in the evening or in rain? | The tracks are floodlit, so evening sessions are possible. Heavy rain makes the surface slippery and the track may pause sessions until it dries.

What happens if I cancel a go-kart booking? | Cancel 4 or more days before the date for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or no-show there is no refund. If the operator cancels for weather or sea conditions, you choose a new date or a full refund.
What should I wear for go-karting on Koh Samui? | Closed shoes and fitted clothes. Flip-flops, long scarves and loose skirts are not safe in a kart. Tie back long hair under the helmet.

faq: How much does parasailing at Lamai cost? | 2,000 THB for a solo flight and 3,000 THB for a tandem flight for two people, each about 10 minutes.
Do you land in the sea when parasailing at Lamai? | No. You take off from and land back on the boat, so you can stay fairly dry; spray is likely.

Is there an age or weight limit for parasailing at Lamai? | The operator publishes none. Tell us ages and weights when you book; children usually fly tandem with an adult, and the crew decides on the day for very light or heavy flyers. Not recommended during pregnancy or with heart conditions.
Is a transfer included with the Lamai parasail? | No. Make your own way to Lamai beach, or ask us for a one-way car at 500 THB per car.
What is included in the Lamai parasailing price? | The flight, harness and life jacket, the boat crew and accident insurance.

Can you parasail at Lamai in November and December? | Often not. The north-east monsoon brings wind and swell to Lamai from about November to January, and the crew will not fly in unsafe conditions. February to September is the most reliable time.

What if my Lamai parasail flight is cancelled or I cancel? | Cancel 4 or more days before the date for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or no-show there is no refund. If the operator cancels for weather or sea conditions, you choose a new date or a full refund.
What should I bring for parasailing in Lamai? | Swimwear or light clothes, sunglasses on a strap and sunscreen. Leave phones on the beach unless they are in a lanyard pouch.

Which sights can the private Samui driver tour include? | Typical stops are Big Buddha, Wat Plai Laem, Hin Lad or Na Muang waterfall, the south-west temples and Taling Ngam viewpoint, the Guan Yu shrine at Hua Thanon, Wat Khunaram and Hin Ta and Hin Yai rocks. The 4x4 can also climb to the Secret Buddha Garden.
Is the driver on the private island tour also a guide? | No. The driver takes you between stops; an English-speaking guide costs 2,500 THB extra if you want commentary at the temples.

Are entrance fees included in the private Samui car tour? | No. Most temples and the rocks are free or ask for a small donation or parking fee; the Secret Buddha Garden and some waterfalls charge a small entry fee in cash.
Can children join the private minibus or 4x4 island tour? | Yes, the price is per vehicle so children travel at no extra cost. Tell us if you need a child seat and we check availability.

Is the private island tour worth doing in the rainy season? | Yes, the vehicle is covered and you can reshuffle stops around showers. From October to December waterfalls are at their fullest but hill roads are muddy, so the 4x4 option is better.

What is the cancellation policy for the private minibus or 4x4 tour? | Cancel 4 or more days before the date for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50% back; within 24 hours or no-show there is no refund. If the operator cancels for weather or sea conditions, you choose a new date or a full refund.

What should we wear for the private temple and waterfall tour? | Clothes that cover shoulders and knees for temples (a sarong in your bag works), swimwear for the waterfall and shoes that grip on wet rock.

Do I need off-road experience for the enduro tour on Koh Samui? | You need to be confident riding a geared motorbike. The beginner ride is designed for people with some enduro experience; complete beginners should choose an ATV tour instead.

Is the enduro bike insured if I crash on Koh Samui? | No. The bikes are not insured, and damage to the bike or kit is charged to the rider. Check that your travel insurance covers off-road motorbike riding before you book.
Is transport to the enduro base included? | No. A two-way car costs 1,000 THB per car, so it is cheaper when several riders share it.
What protective gear do enduro riders get? | Helmet, goggles, gloves, body armour, knee guards and boots, plus a riding shirt and trousers on most routes.
Does the Samui enduro tour run in the rainy season? | Yes, but trails are muddier and harder from October to December, and the guide may shorten or change the route after heavy rain.

Where do we sleep on the Khao Sok lake trip? | In a room with en-suite bathroom at a resort on the lake, reached only by boat. Electricity runs on solar power. We confirm the room type with your booking.
Are meals included on the Khao Sok trip from Samui? | Yes: breakfast, lunch and dinner from lunch on day 1 to breakfast on the last day. Drinks other than water are extra.
